title: $100 in 1962 = $1,112 Today (Real 1962 Footage) #shorts
description:
Since 1962, the US dollar has lost about 91% of its buying power. $100 in 1962 is worth about $1,112 today, and today's $100 buys what about $9 bought in 1962. Prices are about 11 times higher.

Data: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U, CPIAUCSL), U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED: 1962 annual average (30.25) vs September 2026 (336.30).

Footage: real film from 1962, "American Thrift (Part II)" (Jam Handy Organization), Prelinger Archives, public domain: https://archive.org/details/American1962_2
